test_server_sleep: test the server sleep functionality by verifying endpoints stay responsive after idle timeout
test_server_wake_from_sleep: test waking up a sleeping server by sending a POST /completion request with a prompt
test_server_health_after_sleep: test that GET /health and GET /props endpoints return 200 after server goes to sleep
create_server_with_preset: create a test server instance using ServerPreset.tinyllama2() with configurable idle sleep settings
configure_server_idle_timeout: configure the server sleep_idle_seconds property and start it for integration testing
